# Draft:Old Ross Empire

The Old Ross Empire is a self-declared micronation in Ireland. It is ruled by the Emperor and the Old Ross Parliment. Even though it is a landlocked nation, Old Ross has a small navy, the Imperial Navy. It only has one vessel that is currently broken. Old Ross is a neutral country but it has an army, the Imperial Army. Old Ross has its own currency, the Old Ross Pound. The Constitution of Old Ross [Bunreacht na Sean Ros] makes sure Old Ross is a fair, safe and peaceful place for its citizens. English and Irish are the official languages.
